hostname x3
interface Loopback0
 ipv4 address 192.0.2.3 255.255.255.255
!
interface TenGigE0/0/0/0
 description x1
 ipv4 address 198.51.100.10 255.255.255.252
!
route-policy PASS
  pass
end-policy
!
router ospf CORE
 router-id 192.0.2.3
 area 0
  interface Loopback0
   cost 1
   passive enable
  !
  interface TenGigE0/0/0/0
   cost 10
   network point-to-point
  !
 !
!
router bgp 64502
 bgp router-id 192.0.2.3
 address-family ipv4 unicast
 !
 neighbor 192.0.2.1
  remote-as 64502
  description x1
  update-source Loopback0
  address-family ipv4 unicast
  !
 !
!
end
